purpose: Stage and independently review only inert Local Mistral runtime binding from exact conversion-root authority through admitted pinned file identities and verified readable descriptors.
requiredInvariants: This PR remains inert: it does not activate Local Mistral workflow routing, publish provider status, change product/API/database/RBAC/registration/cabinet behavior, or replace REG.RU production authority.

The conversion root must exactly equal /srv/tai-models/conversion-runs/{exactMainSha}/{workflowRunId}-{workflowRunAttempt}; exactMainSha is lowercase SHA-40 and run/attempt are canonical positive decimal integers.

Conversion-root traversal starts at the kernel root directory and opens each canonical component independently with openat2 RESOLVE_BENEATH|RESOLVE_NO_MAGICLINKS|RESOLVE_NO_SYMLINKS plus O_PATH|O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC.
The root anchor and every traversed directory must fstat as a directory owned by uid 0 with no group/world write bits; any syscall, ownership, mode, type or component mismatch fails closed.
Report, model and llama-server identities are obtained only through the already-admitted segment-8 literal O_PATH identity primitive beneath the validated conversion-root FD.
Report, model and llama-server content is accepted only through the already-admitted segment-9 same-inode readable verification primitive with exact authority SHA-256 and required size rules.
The runner never reopens report/model/server by their original conversion-root pathname after identity pinning.
Conversion-report JSON is read only from the verified readable descriptor and must bind the exact conversion main/run/attempt, VERIFIED_RESTORED toolchain status and exact Mistral source revision.

The model SHA-256 and size used by the runtime are derived from the authority-hashed conversion report; the caller still independently binds those derived values to local-mistral-authority.v1.json before invocation.

llama-server --version is executed only through /proc/self/fd/<verified-server-fd> while that descriptor is explicitly inherited by the child, and its output must bind the admitted llama source commit.
The model runtime executable and model input are passed only as /proc/self/fd/<verified-fd> paths with pass_fds; no original filesystem pathname is passed to llama-server.

The runtime remains loopback-only, token-authenticated, bounded by fixed startup/request/response limits, strips ambient LLAMA_ARG_* overrides and fails closed on launch, transport, schema or output errors.
The accepted model/server source is root-owned with no write permission bits under segment-9 authority; root remains outside the untrusted pull-request input boundary.
Local Qwen remains the independent reviewer for this future Local Mistral authority change.
Mandatory SaaS/API keys remain none and new recurring cost remains 0 RUB.
